purpose: Define evidence and launch gates for the five desks without claiming implemented capability or enabling physical orders.

evidence_labels.label: FIXTURE
claims_allowed: software behavior under the declared fixture

evidence_labels.label: REPLAY
claims_allowed: historical simulation result under declared assumptions

evidence_labels.label: LOCAL_PAPER
requirements: observed quote provenance and availability time

evidence_labels.label: ATTESTED_FORWARD
claims_allowed: prospective paper outcome with the named custody scope

evidence_labels.label: BROKER_APPROVED
requirements: broker and venue approval for the exact account and use
evidence_labels.block_reason: PHYSICAL_ORDERS_ENABLED is false; no broker, owner, compliance, or live-capital approval is inferred by this contract.
claims_forbidden: live order submission before every gate is independently verified

global_preflight: source rights and retention permission are effective for the account, instrument, use and time
instrument identity and contract metadata are valid as of the decision time
data freshness, clock, exchange calendar and availability timestamps pass
risk, liquidity, costs, capital and portfolio limits pass
order, fill, cash, position and P&L events reconcile

desk_preflight: point-in-time corporate actions and listing status
quote age, spread, depth and participation cap
intraday margin, turnover and fee stress
effective-dated contract, lot, tick and expiry metadata
executable bid/ask and multi-leg fill stress
Greeks, volatility, margin and expiry/settlement risk
defined maximum loss; naked writing remains excluded
whole-unit quantity and executable exchange price
spread, liquidity, tracking difference and premium/discount
keep market price distinct from NAV and underlying index
effective-dated scheme, plan, option, cutoff and holiday calendar
NAV publication, allotment and settlement lifecycle
never use exchange ticks or assume intraday/same-day execution
